{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any missing or invalid values in customer_age
print("Customer age summary:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].describe())
print("\nAge values count:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Check for invalid values in converted column
print("\nConverted column value counts:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Check for any rows where customer_age is -1 (invalid)
invalid_age_rows = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"\nNumber of rows with invalid age (-1): {len(invalid_age_rows)}")

# Filter for customers who converted
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Check if there are any converted customers with invalid age
invalid_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of converted customers with invalid age (-1): {len(invalid_age_converted)}")

# Compute mean age of customers who converted, excluding those with age = -1
mean_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age_converted"}
